description: Put a picture into the brand's Klaviyo IMAGE LIBRARY for use in emails: a Hermoso render or Library id (list_library gives L0, L1…), a Hermoso link, an upload_file URL, or a public https image link (Klaviyo fetches an outside link itself). Klaviyo takes JPEG, PNG or GIF up to 5 MB, so another format or a bigger file is converted to a JPEG first; a video is refused. Returns Klaviyo's own image row (id and hosted URL). create_klaviyo_template uploads its image itself, so call this only to stock the library. Free. Needs Klaviyo connected (Settings > Connectors > Klaviyo, or connect_connector with a private API key).

hidden.description: keep it out of the visible asset library

image.description: a Library id (L0), a Hermoso or upload_file URL, or a public https image URL

name: upload_klaviyo_image
title: Upload an image to Klaviyo
